source: Demucs vocal stem: may contain multiple voices and instrumental leakage

definitions.time: i * hopSamples / sampleRate; centered windows with zero padding at clip edges
definitions.rms: linear amplitude of the decoded vocal stem; no normalization by song or viewport
definitions.spectralChange: cosine distance between adjacent Hann-window magnitude spectra, 200–6000 Hz; null if unavailable
definitions.candidates: original source timestamps; unfiltered legacy estimates, not word boundaries or impact requests
definitions.landmarks: preceding RMS minimum and steepest positive linear RMS rise up to the candidate frame; frame centers, not an onset interval or confidence bounds
definitions.bandFlux: mean positive adjacent log-mel power change, dB/frame; 64 Hann-window mel filters grouped by center frequency (overlapping supports), 80–1000/1000–3000/3000–8000 Hz; power floor 1e-10; no normalization or extra onset time shift; first frame null
